Shortcuts and presenter legal reminder

Keyboard

1 2 3
Jump to the first nine products in the running order. Use the picker (P) or , and . for the rest.
← →
Previous or next section. In the teleprompter: previous or next script block.
↑ ↓
Scroll the section. In the teleprompter: nudge the script up or down.
T
Teleprompter on or off with the full script. Shift + T opens the 60-second version.
Space
Pause or resume the teleprompter.
[ ] or - =
Teleprompter slower or faster, live.
Esc
Stop the teleprompter, close a panel, or leave a text field.
B
Flash the pinned deal banner so you can restate the offer.
C
Countdown. First press starts it. Press again to pause, and again to resume. Once it has reached zero, C resets it to the full time. Shift + C resets it at any point. No sound plays at zero.
S
Settings: show prices, CTA, countdown length, Black Friday styling, text size.
? or H
This cheat sheet.
/
Search every script line, spec, price, FAQ and objection across all three TVs. Arrow keys pick a result, Enter jumps to it, Shift + Enter asks AI instead.
A
Questions: ask AI a viewer question, or add a FAQ live. Added FAQs appear under FAQ for everyone with the console open.
V
Presenter view: product on the left, and on the right whatever the presenter picks (teleprompter, script, key points, NLP, specs, compare, questions). Open the link with #presenter on the end to start in it.
P , .
Product picker, previous product, next product. 1 to 9 jump to the first nine.
N
NLP: what real buyers love and complain about, their own words, and NLP lines built from the reviews.
K
Cue panel: send a quick or typed cue to every screen with the console open. X dismisses a cue on this screen.
Synced
When on, switching TV on one screen switches every synced screen. Turn it off on a screen to browse without moving everyone.
Dashed fields
Click any dashed field to edit it. Enter or Esc to finish. Saved on this computer only.

Before you go live

  1. Show prices stay blank until you set them. Never invent a discount, and never quote a saving until the show price is set.
  2. Year-low price claims are off by default. Black Friday styling is separate and does not switch any claim on. The claim only appears after you tick the verification box for that product in Settings.
  3. Under the CMA and ASA rules you can only say a price is the lowest of the year, has never been cheaper, or is the lowest ever if the show price is verifiably the lowest UK selling price for that exact model this year, including the seller's own earlier prices. A was price must be a genuine, recent selling price, not an inflated RRP. A save against a retailer needs a current, checked price and the retailer's name.
  4. TikTok listing prices on the public web page are not reliable around Black Friday: app-only deals, LIVE prices and vouchers do not show there, and prices moved during the day. The console does not show them. Confirm every price in TikTok Seller Center on the day and type the show price in yourself.
  5. Ninja air fryer listing: the AF200UK does not Bake or Dehydrate and has no recipe guide confirmed, whatever the listing says. Shark PowerDetect: Shark gives 5 years' guarantee on registration, not the 2 years on the listing.
  6. Shark CryoGlow: use only Shark's own wording on results, say results vary, and read the safety list (pregnancy, certain medicines, eye conditions) before demonstrating.
  7. Hisense 55 inch: do not confuse it with the 55E7STUK PRO (144Hz, 4 HDMI 2.1, about £499). Currys and John Lewis only list the PRO.
  8. Guarantees: Hisense 2 years from the manufacturer, LG 1 year. Do not promise the John Lewis 5 year or Richer Sounds 6 year cover.
  9. The Xbox controller deal on the Hisense listings has no written terms. Only mention it once the producer confirms what is included.
  10. Say the weaknesses plainly. Both Hisense sets are native 60Hz and not Mini LED. The LG B6 is not the brighter evo panel of the C6 and has no HDR10+.
  11. No invented review scores, awards, stock levels, selling out lines or celebrity endorsements.
  12. Ask AI answers are drafts built from this research. Read the check line before you say anything out loud.
